title: reader config.rs re-export creates silent TOML contract on stoa_auth::UserCredential
description: If stoa_auth::UserCredential adds/removes/renames a serde field, reader TOML config silently breaks for operators (wrong-type error at parse time, no compile error). The re-export in config.rs ties the reader's on-disk config format directly to stoa_auth internals. The existing comment explains the type-identity rationale but does not call out this TOML contract. Add a doc comment to the pub use line noting that field names are part of the operator-visible config format — any rename in stoa_auth::UserCredential is a breaking config change requiring a migration note.
